CARDSHARP-MARKED_DECK.title: Marked Deck
CARDSHARP-MARKED_DECK.description: The Pot: each [gold]Showdown[/gold] deals [blue]2[/blue] more damage than the last this combat, up to [blue]+7[/blue].
CARDSHARP-MARKED_DECK.flavor: Tiny pinpricks on the backs. You can feel the aces.
CARDSHARP-STACKED_DECK.title: Stacked Deck
CARDSHARP-STACKED_DECK.description: The Pot: each [gold]Showdown[/gold] deals [blue]2[/blue] more damage than the last this combat, up to [blue]+10[/blue].
CARDSHARP-STACKED_DECK.flavor: Every card is exactly where she wants it. Every single one.
CARDSHARP-LUCKY_COIN.title: Lucky Coin
CARDSHARP-LUCKY_COIN.description: Your first [gold]Showdown[/gold] each combat counts as [blue]1[/blue] hand higher.
CARDSHARP-LUCKY_COIN.flavor: Heads, she wins. Tails, you lose.
CARDSHARP-DEALERS_BUTTON.title: Dealer's Button
CARDSHARP-DEALERS_BUTTON.flavor: Whoever holds it deals the next hand.
CARDSHARP-GOLDEN_JOKER.title: Golden Joker
CARDSHARP-GOLDEN_JOKER.description: At the start of each combat, shuffle [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Jokers[/gold] into your draw pile.
CARDSHARP-GOLDEN_JOKER.flavor: Gilded, grinning, and never where you left it.
CARDSHARP-CROUPIERS_RAKE.title: Croupier's Rake
CARDSHARP-CROUPIERS_RAKE.flavor: The house always takes its cut.
